ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixel distribution with sparse, localized high-intensity (white) focal points comprising less than 2% of the total visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark contiguous region across both lobes. Spatially isolated, high-contrast white circular spots (approximately 12-15 distinct pixel clusters) are distributed non-uniformly across the medial and distal sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with a wide obtuse angle; the vertex is clearly defined against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) observed continuously along the trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve extending from the central notch toward the dorsal-facing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle attachment sites, predominantly located in the mid-fluke regions of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, faint linear high-contrast streaks oriented diagonally relative to the leading edge, primarily visible on the medial portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor irregular nicks and jagged pixel-level deviations from a smooth curve along the superior trailing edge of the right lobe.
